tour.step1_content: Easily toggle between "Decks" (ready-to-study flashcard packages) and "Note Types" (card design layouts).
tour.step2_content_decks: Share decks you have created with the community to learn together or collaborate on updates.
tour.step2_content_notetypes: Design your own card layouts or publish Note Types to the Marketplace.
tour.step3_content: Quickly search by deck name, JLPT level (N5 - N1), topical vocabulary, or author name.
tour.step4_content: Quick filter by core categories: JLPT N5, N4, N3, N2, N1, Vocabulary, Kanji, Conversation, IT / Tech...
tour.step5_content: Browse algorithmic "Recommended" decks, "Popular" most downloaded decks, or "Newest" submissions.
tour.step6_content: Each card displays topic badges, pricing (Free/Paid), author name, star rating ⭐ and total card count.
tour.step7_content: Click to preview sample cards, see actual layouts, and install directly into your account to start studying immediately!
